import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
base=[1/P, np.log(1+P)**2]
def test(cols):
    A=np.column_stack(base+cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((y-A@c)**2)/np.var(y), c
print(test([P,P**2,t*P,t*P**2])[0])
print(test([P,P**2,t*P,t*P**2,t**2*P,t**2*P**2])[0])
print(test([P,P**2,t*P,t*P**2,np.exp(-t)*P,np.exp(-t)*P**2])[0])
print(test([P,P**2,np.sin(t)*P,np.cos(t)*P,np.sin(t)*P**2,np.cos(t)*P**2])[0])
print(test([P,P**2,np.sqrt(t)*P,np.sqrt(t)*P**2])[0])
print(test([P,P**2,np.log(t)*P,np.log(t)*P**2])[0])
